title: A chain build's step 9b keeps its 10 and 12 minute windows, cut shorter only by the 2 hour deadline
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm the test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: chainRepairLimits(30 min) is stopNewWorkMs 10 min and returnByMs 12 min, not the 90 minutes left to the deadline.
Started 5 minutes before the deadline, 9b starts new work only until the deadline and returns 2 minutes later.
After the deadline, 9b starts no new work and returns within the 15 minute handover window.
The 2 hour chain deadline and the run cut of 135 minutes are unchanged.

tests: step 9b keeps its 10 and 12 minute windows in a chain build too, cut shorter only by the deadline
